def factor_vol_asym_tail_volume_60volwin(df):
    """Tail volatility asymmetry filtered by volume with longer volume lookback: log ratio of EWMA of downside tail squared returns to upside tail squared returns, multiplied by a smoother volume ratio (60-day) to confirm conviction."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["open"]) / df_copy["open"].replace(0, np.nan)
    std_20 = intraday_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    down_tail = np.where(intraday_ret < -1 * std_20, intraday_ret**2, 0)
    up_tail = np.where(intraday_ret > 1 * std_20, intraday_ret**2, 0)
    ewma_down = pd.Series(down_tail, index=df_copy.index).ewm(halflife=20).mean()
    ewma_up = pd.Series(up_tail, index=df_copy.index).ewm(halflife=20).mean()
    tail_ratio = np.where((ewma_up > 1e-8) & (ewma_down > 1e-8),
                          np.log(ewma_down / ewma_up),
                          0.0)
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=60)
    factor = tail_ratio * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_vol_asym_tail_volume_60volwin"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asym_tail_volume_60volwin"]
description: Mutation of the parent tail volatility asymmetry factor. Preserves the core mechanism: log-ratio of down-tail to up-tail squared intraday returns with EWMA smoothing identifies asymmetric risk. The mutation increases the volume ratio window from 20 to 60 days, smoothing the volume confirmation term to reduce transient noise while retaining the conviction filter. This targets improved IC/ICIR through a more stable volume scaling, while the parent's strong RankIC and RankICIR are expected to be maintained by the unchanged tail asymmetry structure.
